title: UPLAND R80 current model-family configurations
notes: The exact current Chinese page documents a Shimano 105 R7120 2x12 R80 at approximately 8.4 kg bare and fitted MAXXIS Pursuer 700x28C tires. Current regional exact pages also expose 105 Di2 and Ultegra builds at 8.3 and 8.1 kg. None establishes the exact weight of the retained CNY 8,999 Magene build or a manufacturer maximum tire clearance.
